_comment: Copy to vaults.json. path = folder with the notes; obsidian_vault + uri_prefix build obsidian://open links (uri_prefix is needed when the Obsidian vault root is a parent of path). exclude = folders the scanner skips. readonly = folders the AI must never edit. bridge_folder = where bridge notes go in this vault. mask_titles = never show this vault's file names in the map (NDA): the map uses a title from decisions.json or an anonymous label.

vaults.name: Personal
vaults.privacy: private: only ideas and techniques leave this vault, no biography, money or relationships

vaults.name: Work
vaults.privacy: NDA: only anonymized methods and conclusions leave this vault, no names, company numbers, vendors or quotes
